rows.detail: Students reading below 900L fell from 8 to 2.
It now begins at 1138L, up from 1080L, and the lowest Lexile in the group rose from 405L to 685L.
Students at 1400L or above grew from 21 (23%) to 25 (28%), and the top quarter now begins at 1430L, up from 1380L.

rows.change: More readers over both grade-level lines
rows.detail: 82% read at or above 1080L (was 78%), and 65% read at or above 1185L (was 59%).

The median is 1260L, 25 points under the prior year's 1285L. This group tested a grade younger. Fewer students landed in the 1300s (15, down from 24) and more landed between 1185L and 1299L (18, up from 10).

In 2024-25 the winter group read higher than spring (median 1333L against 1160L). In 2025-26 spring read higher than winter (1330L against 1148L). The gap follows which students test each term, so check each term's readers early.

rows.change: Most Developing students can already read the text
rows.detail: 27 of the 36 Developing students read at or above 1080L. For them the next step is writing and analysis, not reading level.

rows.change: Beginning students need reading support first
rows.detail: All 7 Beginning students read below 1080L, from 685L to 1065L.
